content.comment_body: Hello, I have a 4-20mA sensor input connected to a pressure sensor and a 0-10V output linked to a frequency converter. The requirement is to control the output to the frequency converter in order to maintain a set pressure using function block diagrams. How can this be achieved?
Is this just another post similar to the one about conferences in projects?
This thread is closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread titled 'in-out' was published in the [product_name] - Software section. Best regards, [user_name]
